limits_note: Topic 2 Arm H2 review half. Exactly Arm S per-job settings (Opus 5 at effort max, 160 responses, 3600 s, $20 per job), 12 admissions, three workers, $150 arm cap. Reconcile and compare only, over h2-research frozen outputs.

cost_control.semantics: Admission and every native request check captured usage plus live stage allowances plus terminal unresolved charges against the unchanged arm cap. Stage average after two terminal same-arm stage jobs with reconciled native usage, otherwise12. Live usage is reporting only. Job-end native records determine captured valuation; an unreconciled terminal job retains12 separately as unresolved liability. Estimates are not billed cash or a mathematical spend bound.
cost_control.cancellation_boundary: before_every_native_model_request for the codex transport gate; after every native response and before the next request for the claude and zero-tariff omp adapters
cost_control.unresolved_usage: Every new v4 terminal job without complete native accounting retains12 USD unresolved charge, separate from captured usage; counts against cap indefinitely. Prior baseline unknowns remain visible with unchanged historical valuation.

claude.cost_source: CLI-reported total_cost_usd per job, floored by the preserved first-party Opus 5 tariff applied to captured tokens
claude.request_ceiling: adapter counts native assistant responses on the CLI stream and terminates at 40; CLI --max-budget-usd 12 per job

union.cost_source: opencode catalogue tariff captured 2026-09-16 (omp models find union-alpha --json): every category 0
union.request_ceiling: adapter counts native model_usage records and terminates at 40; no pre-dispatch monetary gate is required at a zero tariff

hybrid_arm_deepseek_metadata.applies_to: continuation 3 hybrid arm research model; not the continuation 4 arms. Per-arm selectors are under continuation4_arms.

capability.boundary: Native assistant messages are counted on the CLI's own stream; the process is terminated before the next request when the ceiling is reached. The CLI's --max-budget-usd stops the run inside the runtime, below any HTTP retry loop.
capability.known_limits: A retry of one in-flight request is not separately counted; the monetary ceiling is the CLI's, not a per-attempt gate.

codex_status: fail-closed in continuation 4: editing cost_watch.py and native_receipts.py invalidated the recorded transport-gate proof, so codex_native reports available=false. A codex arm needs the proof re-recorded against the new meter and collector hashes before it can launch.
